title: French Tofu Galette
description: A French-inspired vegan dish made with crispy tofu and oozing galette, perfect for a light dinner.
instructions: Press and drain excess water from the tofu.
Cut the tofu into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes.
In a shallow dish, mix together thyme, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Coat the tofu cubes with the herb mixture, shaking off excess.
Brush the galette with olive oil on both sides.
Place the tofu cubes on one half of the galette, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border.
Fold the other half of the galette over the tofu, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the top of the galette with olive oil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
